clarified_indicator_logic.ema3_ema9: Fresh 3/9 cross is the early directional trigger. The indicator state/color remains in that direction until the next opposite 3/9 cross.
clarified_indicator_logic.ema9_ema20: 9/20 is slower confirmation/ratification. It is measured separately and is not required for entry in this experiment.
clarified_indicator_logic.reason: The user-provided chart shows the fast 3/9 state turning first and the 9/20 relationship confirming later during stronger directional movement.

unchanged_core: LONG: prior bar sweeps below latest confirmed structural low and signal closes back above it
SHORT: prior bar sweeps above latest confirmed structural high and signal closes back below it
Bollinger 20/2 touch or pierce on prior/signal bar
fresh EMA3/EMA9 cross on the fully closed signal candle
signal closes beyond EMA9 in trade direction
signal is rocket rejection or body engulfing
LONG signal low > prior low; SHORT signal high < prior high
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal
entry_logic.non_lateral_filter_v3: EMA9 must have directional slope on the signal bar: EMA9[t] > EMA9[t-1] for LONG; EMA9[t] < EMA9[t-1] for SHORT. No optimized magnitude threshold.
entry_logic.why_change: Replaces the V1 three-transition EMA20 monotonic filter and avoids the tuned 5-bar/5%-bandwidth threshold used in V2.

exit.target: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth measured at signal close
exit.time_exit: close of third bar if target/stop not hit
exit.ema9_ema20_extension: DISABLED; ratification is observation only in this run

ratification_measurement.aligned_at_signal: Whether EMA9 is already on the same side of EMA20 at signal close
ratification_measurement.fresh_cross_during_trade: Whether 9/20 crosses in the trade direction after entry and before the V3 trade exits
ratification_measurement.bars_to_ratification: Number of held bars from entry to the fresh 9/20 ratification event
ratification_measurement.comparison: Report performance for already-ratified, ratifies-during-trade, and unratified groups without changing exits.
